transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Ever since they changed my hours at the warehouse and brought in that new inventory system, I feel like I’m falling apart. I’ve been missing shifts and church commitments, snapping at my family. Some mornings I just sit there in my work boots wondering if I can even face going in.
Do you feel these problems started because of the changes at work?
Yes. It really started when they changed my hours and brought in that new inventory system. Since then, I just feel overwhelmed by the place.
Since this started, have you been feeling down or depressed?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed. I just know I feel overwhelmed when I think about going in there.
When you’re away from work, do you still feel this overwhelmed?
It follows me home some. I’ve been snapping at my family and missing church things, which isn’t like me. But it’s worst when I’m thinking about the warehouse or getting ready to go in.
Since this started, have you been feeling sad most days?
I don’t know that I’ve been sad most days. It’s more that I feel wound up and overwhelmed when work comes to mind.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things, not just work?
No, not really. It’s mainly work that gets me wound up.
Since this started, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure I’ve noticed that, no. I still like the things I usually like when I’m able to settle down.
Since this started, have you been feeling hopeless?
I wouldn’t say hopeless, no. I’m overwhelmed by it, but I haven’t really felt like there’s no point or anything.
Since this started, have you been feeling anxious?
Yes. Ever since they changed my hours and brought in that new inventory system, I’ve been on edge. Some mornings I just sit in my work boots wondering if I can even face going in.
Since this started, have you been feeling tearful?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve really noticed myself being tearful.
Since this started, have you been crying more than usual?
I can’t really say I’ve noticed crying more. It hasn’t stood out to me.
Since this started, have you been feeling discouraged?

Yes. I feel pretty discouraged. With the new hours and that inventory system, it feels like I’m falling apart—I’m missing shifts and even church commitments, and some mornings I just don’t know if I can face going in.
Since this started, have you been feeling depressed?

Yeah, I think so. Ever since the hours changed and they brought in that new system, I just feel like I’m falling apart. Some mornings I’m sitting there in my work boots wondering if I can even face going in.
Since this started, have you been feeling anxious and depressed?

Yes, both, I think. Since the warehouse changed the hours and brought in that new system, I’ve been really on edge and down. I’m missing shifts, snapping at my family, and some mornings I just sit there in my boots wondering if I can face going in.
Since this started, have you been feeling depressed most days?
I’m not sure I’d say most days. I’ve been feeling low a lot, but it comes and goes.
Since this started, have you been feeling down nearly every day?
I can’t really say it’s nearly every day. I’ve had a lot of low days, but there are days where it eases up some.
Since this started, have you been losing your appetite?
I haven’t really noticed a change in my appetite, no.
Since this started, have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really paid close attention to that.
Since this started, have you often felt sad or down?
I’m not sure I’d say often. I’ve had some low days, but it comes and goes.
Since this started, have you been feeling like crying?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed myself feeling like crying, exactly.
